# ClinicOps

> Clinical and device operations support for Denmark and the EU: eCOA delivery planning, regulatory records for medical devices, and Danish-language and pharmacovigilance support. Free browser-local tools.

Core pages:
- ClinicOps | Clinical and device operations support for Denmark and the EU: https://clinicops.dk/ - Clinical and device operations support for Denmark and the EU: eCOA delivery planning, regulatory records for medical devices, and Danish-language and pharmacovigilance support. Free browser-local tools.
- About ClinicOps | EU MedTech Regulatory Data Integrity: https://clinicops.dk/about - How ClinicOps works: the method, how projects are run, and what is not claimed.
- Scope a ClinicOps Review | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/assessment-intake - Build a concise scope brief for a ClinicOps Regulatory Change Integrity Review or portfolio integrity scan in your browser. No form data is transmitted by this page.
- Contact ClinicOps | EU MedTech Regulatory Data Integrity: https://clinicops.dk/contact - Contact ClinicOps to scope a Regulatory Change Integrity Review, a portfolio integrity scan, Denmark market access or Danish pharmacovigilance support.
- Learning hub: life-science operations and the Nordic market | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/learn - Free, sourced learning for people who run or oversee regulated life-science work in Europe, with a Nordic focus: video, workflow maps, dated references and browser-only tools.
- Solution: Regulatory Change Integrity Review | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/services - The Regulatory Change Integrity Review: one approved change reconciled against EUDAMED, UDI, certificates, SS(C)P and controlled records, with closure evidence.

Solution and use cases:
- EU Authorised Representative Portfolio Intelligence | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/authorised-representative-portfolio-intelligence - Evidence reconciliation and transition prioritisation for authorised representatives and consultancies managing many MedTech manufacturers.
- Class III and Implantable MDR Transition Intelligence | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/class-iii-transition - Legacy versus MDR paths, certificate and transition timing, and SS(C)P duty context for class III and implantable device portfolios.
- Denmark Reference: Clinical Trial and Device Study Routes | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/denmark-market-access - Denmark reference for clinical trials and device studies: CTR route map, device investigation route, Danish language matrix, dated change log.
- Choosing an EU Authorised Representative | MDR and IVDR | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/eu-authorised-representative - What to check before you sign an EU authorised representative mandate under MDR and IVDR. ClinicOps does not act as an authorised representative.
- EU MDR Regulatory Data Integrity for Global MedTech | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/eu-mdr-regulatory-integrity - Evidence-controlled EU MDR regulatory information review, remediation and change operations for medical-device manufacturers worldwide supporting the EU market.
- EUDAMED registration date 28 Nov 2026: work plan | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/eudamed-transition - The Commission timeline gives 28 Nov 2026 (a Saturday) for registering devices placed on the market before mandatory use. Turn portfolio evidence into a work plan.
- Regulatory Change Integrity Review | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/evidence-change-control-pack - One declared change and evidence population turned into a source register, change-surface matrix, unresolved queue and closure packet.
- Evidence pack checklist | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/evidence-pack-checklist - What to gather before a ClinicOps review: exports, records, version-control expectations and what not to send.
- Working with partners | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/expert-network - Narrow units of work for language-service providers, CROs, eCOA vendors and manufacturers: written scope, no silent subcontracting, one accountable owner.
- Medical Device Regulatory Document Control | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/medical-device-document-control - Reconciliation-as-evidence review of consistency across EUDAMED records, IFU, labelling and market-language versions for MedTech, with RA/QA retaining sign-off.
- EU Medical Device Regulatory Intelligence | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/regulatory-intelligence - EU medical device regulatory intelligence with the evidence intact: capture signals, keep actor context, separate screening from conclusions.
- SS(C)P operations explained: who does what | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/sscp-operations - Plain explainer: what an SS(C)P is, who draws it up and who uploads and validates it in EUDAMED, the dates that apply, and where ClinicOps stops.
- How a bounded Regulatory Change Integrity Review works | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/what-a-pilot-looks-like - How a bounded ClinicOps Regulatory Change Integrity Review runs, what evidence it uses, what you receive, and who decides.

Free browser-local tools and examples:
- Change Surface Mapper | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/change-surface-mapper - Map one approved change across affected systems, records, documents and owners, in your browser. A portable evidence brief; nothing is uploaded.
- COA type finder and inventory | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/coa-type-finder - Free, browser-only COA type finder and inventory: sort an assessment by type and list a study's assessments with gaps flagged. Nothing is sent.
- CTIS Initial Application Clock | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/ctis-clock - Planning dates for an EU clinical trial initial application in CTIS under Regulation 536/2014, with the winter pause. Browser-local, calendar export.
- Danish DHPC Submission Checker | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/danish-dhpc-checker - Free checklist for a Danish DHPC to the Danish Medicines Agency's documented rules: submission pack, format, plain-Danish translation, evidence. Browser-local.
- Danish Local-Literature Source Register | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/danish-pv-literature-register - Source-verified register of Danish periodicals for GVP Module VI local-literature monitoring, with a justification memo and screening-log generator.
- eCOA Delivery Workbench | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/ecoa-delivery-workbench - Free browser-local workbench for eCOA study delivery: licensing and translation plan, Nordic screenshot review, testing pack, risk and change control.
- eCOA licence and translation lead-time planner | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/ecoa-lead-time-planner - Free, browser-only planner: from instruments, languages and a kick-off date to the earliest first-participant-in date and the version that sets it. Nothing is sent.
- Visit and diary burden estimator | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/ecoa-visit-burden - Free, browser-only estimator: minutes and items per visit, per study week and in total, from the times you enter. Nothing is sent to ClinicOps.
- Free Regulatory Change Integrity Check | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/integrity-check - Build a browser-local evidence packet for one regulatory change: provenance, downstream comparison, gaps, owner routing, JSON fingerprint.
- Regulatory Integrity Scanner | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/integrity-scanner - Check one approved change against downstream records, or scan a portfolio export for missing fields, duplicates and conflicts. Browser-local, exportable.
- SDEA / PV Agreement Clause Checker | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/sdea-clause-checker - Screen a PV agreement or SDEA against the clause set required from 12 February 2026 by Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/1466. Browser-local.
- Interactive Regulatory Integrity Specimen Register | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/specimen-register/ - A synthetic integrity register: traceable reference evidence, observations, discrepancy states, review owners and explicit human decisions.
- Technical File Consistency Check | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/technical-file-consistency - Paste or upload a PDF for each of up to five technical-documentation sources and get a severity-banded divergence report. Browser-local.
- Tools: Integrity Scanner and Evidence Utilities | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/tools - Browser-local regulatory data integrity tools: the Regulatory Integrity Scanner, identifier check, change and consistency utilities, PV utilities and specimens.
- ClinicOps Class III Transition Map — Sanitized Sample: https://clinicops.dk/transition-map-sample/ - Sanitized fictional sample of the ClinicOps Class III Transition Map work-plan format.

- Clinical operations workflow map | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/clinical-operations-workflow-map - Map of the work in an EU clinical study, planning to archive: six phases, twelve lanes, what each step leaves behind, and clocks where the text was read.
- COA and eCOA in Denmark and the Nordics | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/coa-nordic - What the Nordic authorities say about electronic participant assessments, language, ethics review and data protection, and what is unconfirmed. Dated sources.
- COA types and what each asks of an eCOA study | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/coa-types - The four clinical outcome assessment types, questions to settle before choosing an instrument, and what regulators say about electronic versions. Dated sources.
- COA and eCOA learning hub: video, workflow, types, free tools | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/ecoa - Learn eCOA planning: a 12-minute walkthrough, the workflow map, COA types, Nordic context and four free browser-only tools. Nothing is sent to ClinicOps.
- eCOA workflow map from decision to close-out | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/ecoa-workflow - Twelve steps of an eCOA study, from the decision to close-out: what to settle, what each leaves behind, which free tool helps. A synthesis, not a standard.

Policies:
- Privacy Notice | ClinicOps: https://clinicops.dk/privacy-notice/ - How ClinicOps processes personal data: website, email enquiries, client engagements, and business-development outreach, including your right to object.

Operating boundaries:
- ClinicOps structures evidence, reconciliation and operational change; it does not turn machine findings into legal, regulatory, clinical, safety, quality or compliance determinations.
- Missing public records or links do not by themselves establish non-compliance.
- Source authority, professional judgement and release decisions remain explicit human responsibilities.
- Public-source coverage is bounded by the declared method and evidence population.
- Independent experts are engaged only within a defined project scope after credential, availability and conflict checks; their participation does not transfer reserved professional authority to ClinicOps.
